app.title: Pactaris
app.description: Consensual dynamics, built around privacy and choice.
foundation.title: Instance foundation
foundation.description: This development build verifies the instance runtime. Household workflows and sign-in are not available yet.
foundation.offline: The instance could not be reached. Try again when the connection is restored.
foundation.notEnabled: Sign-in is not enabled in this foundation checkpoint.
cli.help: Usage: install.sh|update.sh|status.sh|resume.sh --component identity|instance|gateway --root PATH [--config FILE] [--repository URL --revision FULL_SHA] [--apply]. Without --apply, install/update/resume only show a plan. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md for prerequisites and limits.
cli.arguments: Invalid command arguments. Use --help for usage.
cli.preflight: A required prerequisite or configuration check failed ({check}).
cli.exists: This component is already installed; use update.sh.
cli.locked: Another operation is already running for this component.
cli.failed: The operation failed. The existing configuration and data were preserved. Check the component service logs.
cli.plan: Installation/update plan only; no services or persistent files were changed.
cli.installed: The component was activated and passed its local health check.
cli.recovery: The previous application release was restored. Database rollback is not performed automatically.
cli.failedRecovery: Activation and automatic application recovery failed. Operator intervention is required; configuration and data were retained.
cli.command: Running {tool}; command arguments and child output are kept private.
cli.commandFailed: Command {tool} failed ({code}); configuration and data were retained.
cli.resuming: Resuming the staged first installation of {component} at {revision}; existing configuration and secrets are preserved.
cli.interrupted: Operation interrupted; configuration and data were retained. Use resume.sh for a staged first installation; do not delete volumes or secrets.
cli.incomplete: A staged installation exists without a successful completion record. Use resume.sh with the original full release SHA; preserve configuration, secrets and volumes.
cli.commandLog: Protected command diagnostics were saved to {path}.
errors.request: The request could not be accepted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.loginUnavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Start a new sign-in attempt.
portal.title: Your dynamics
portal.signInDescription: Sign in to see the dynamics you belong to.
portal.notFound: This dynamic is unavailable or you no longer have access.
portal.workspacePending: Your membership has been checked. Dynamic tools are coming in a later release.
portal.partial: Some dynamics could not be checked. Please try again later.
portal.emptyDescription: Create a dynamic to begin. Invitations will be available in a later release.
cli.loginPlan: Prepare the existing local Identity/Instance installation for the gateway at {publicOrigin}; no changes were applied.
cli.loginPrepared: Login preparation completed for {publicOrigin}. Gateway configuration: {path}. Install/update the runtimes and configure public ingress before testing sign-in.
cli.updateHelp: Run update.sh as root to fetch main and update installed components. Options: --check (plan only), --root PATH, --component gateway|instance|identity, --revision FULL_SHA, --repository URL. --apply is accepted for compatibility; applying is now the default.
cli.updateRoot: Run the updater as root so it can read protected deployment state and perform backups.
cli.updateFetching: Fetching Pactaris source; installed configuration and data are preserved.
cli.updateSelected: Selected source revision {revision}; all components use this exact revision.
cli.updateState: Installed state for {component} is invalid or its release is missing; no automatic reset is performed.
cli.updateSource: The requested source revision or staged updater could not be verified.
cli.updateIdentityReview: The pinned Identity provider images changed. A reviewed provider-upgrade procedure is required; no component updates were started.
cli.updateStopped: An update step failed ({code}); later components were not updated. Earlier successful component updates remain active.
cli.updateUnchanged: No deployment change is needed for {component}.
cli.updateChecked: Update plan checked for {revision}; no services or application data were changed.
cli.updateComplete: Installed components are healthy after the update to {revision}; unchanged Identity deployments retain their own revision.
cli.updateArchived: An inactive staged update was preserved at {path}; retrying with a clean release directory.
cli.updatePrerequisite: Protected migration/backup credentials are missing or unsafe for {component}. Complete the documented deployment preparation before updating; existing data was retained.
errors.commandConflict: This operation conflicts with an earlier request. Refresh before trying again.
onboarding.createDescription: Create a private space for your agreed dynamic. Creating it does not accept any relationship agreement or assign anyone a dynamic role.
onboarding.name: Dynamic name
onboarding.createPending: A registration may still be in progress. Retry with the same name to resume it. Completed registrations appear in your dynamics list.
onboarding.leaveConfirm: Leaving ends your access to this dynamic. If you are its last owner, the remaining group is paused. If nobody remains, the dynamic closes. Records are not deleted.
onboarding.leavePending: Your departure has not yet been confirmed. Retry this request to check and finish it.
onboarding.limit: The creation limit for this installation has been reached. Pending registrations also count. You can still leave a dynamic.
onboarding.noInstance: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
onboarding.closed: This registration has ended. Refresh your dynamics before starting another.
onboarding.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Retry the same request; it may already have been saved.
cli.updateRegistry: Registering the co-located Instance using its protected local configuration.
cli.updateRegistryPlan: The co-located Instance will be registered after successful component updates.
cli.updateRegistrySeparate: Separate backend CAs detected; existing registry data is preserved and explicit fleet enrollment is required.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.createDescription: Invite someone to join as a participant. Pending invitations reserve a place for 48 hours.
invitations.shareDescription: Copy and share this private link with the intended recipient. Keep the link: it cannot be recovered after a reload. You can revoke an invitation and create a replacement.
invitations.copyManual: Select and copy the link manually.
invitations.invalidLink: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the original link again.
invitations.signInThenReopen: Sign in with the invited verified email, then reopen the original invitation link. Joining is never automatic.
invitations.noConsent: Joining does not accept a relationship, dynamic role or agreement. Those require separate choices. You can leave the dynamic.
invitations.pending: Your response is being confirmed. Retry the same response to check its outcome.
invitations.left: That earlier membership has ended. A new invitation is required to join again.
invitations.unknownCreate: The invitation outcome is unknown. Retry with the same email and request. After a reload, review existing invitations before creating a replacement.
invitations.unknownResponse: Your response could not be confirmed. Retry to check the same request.
invitations.invalid: Check the invitation details and try again.
invitations.denied: This invitation is unavailable for this account.
invitations.conflict: This invitation has changed, expired or already been handled. Ask the sender for a new invitation.
invitations.capacity: There are no unreserved member places available. Review pending invitations or the member limit.
invitations.proof: A recent verified email assertion is required from this sign-in. Sign in again, then reopen the original link.
invitations.unavailable: Invitations are temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
members.title: Members and ownership
members.description: Technical permissions are separate from dynamic roles and relationship agreements.
members.name: Your name in this dynamic
members.nameDescription: Optional. This name is visible to current members of this dynamic. Leave it empty to show your membership ID.
members.removeDescription: This member will lose access immediately. Their pending invitations and ownership offers will be invalidated. Rejoining requires a new invitation and membership.
members.transferDescription: Ownership changes only after explicit acceptance. The recipient becomes an owner and the sender becomes a participant. Other owners remain owners. This changes administration, not relationship consent, billing or anyone's pause. An offer expires after 24 hours. You can still leave without waiting for acceptance.
members.confirmed: The operation was confirmed. The refreshed member list shows current permissions.
members.unknown: The outcome is not yet confirmed. Retry the same request or refresh to check its receipt.
members.retryDescription: Keep this page open to retry the original request. Leaving the dynamic remains available.
members.otherPending: An earlier operation is awaiting confirmation. Background receipt checks do not repeat the change.
members.invalid: Check the member details and try again.
members.denied: This membership or operation is unavailable for this account.
members.conflict: Membership or ownership has changed. Refresh the list before trying again.
members.reauthenticate: Sign in again before removing a member or offering/accepting ownership, then return to this dynamic.
members.unavailable: Member administration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
